text:
miko: seeing repeated tx queue spikes on eu-west-dedicated-5 around 01:10 UTC, p99 token latency up ~2.5x

dave: confirmed on rack-5 top-of-rack. nvlink stalls + high PCIe utilization when ml-ingest-77 runs.

asha: is it dataset streaming or RPC fanout?

miko: mix of both. many small RPCs fall behind when big parameter fetches start.

ryan: sounds like noisy neighbor. prefer soft mitigation first: eBPF mark heavy flows + tc classes to deprioritize >150MB/s flows.

dave: we've got a small prototype that marks and shapes; low overhead. rollback is just `tc qdisc del dev eth0 root`.

miko: I'll canary on rack-5c in 10m and collect pre/post p99s.

infra-bot: Incident INC-4721 created: "eu-west-dedicated-5 egress saturation". On-call: ryan.

asha: I'll run impact sims for top-ten tenants and flag any billing/runtime regressions.

ryan: if canary reduces p99 by >40% with <3% CPU cost, we roll region-wide as default soft-isolate and offer paid hard carveouts. Keep opt-out for enterprise.

miko: will post dashboards and PR with scripts + runbook snippets.
